description: This Java class defines a custom exception (JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException) used in JSON processing, specifically for handling invalid field selector formats. It includes a builder for creating exception instances with detailed error messages.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException
classes.description: A final class extending JsonRuntimeException, representing an exception thrown when a JSON field selector is in an invalid format.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for fluently creating instances of JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException, allowing setting of custom messages related to invalid field selectors.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static method returning a new instance of the Builder class for constructing JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException objects.
